uiText.s8e21362d: Each line is a strict JSON value with lossless numbers. Blank lines fail; a final line ending is allowed.
uiText.s680be70a: Each key maps to a non-empty string array, retaining repeated parameters and empty values. + means a space. Original encoding style is not preserved.
uiText.s3e77450f: Calculate and compare MD5 checksums for text and files, including line batches and HMAC. Entirely local.
uiText.s7db48bc4: Hashes original bytes without trimming or newline changes. MD5, SHA-1 and CRC32 are for compatibility/checksums, not security signatures.
uiText.sd25a27b: Keys are only used for the current task and never saved. Cleared after completion, cancellation or leaving the tool.
uiText.s58f4da86: Decode only, signature NOT verified. Only three-part JWTs are supported. Decoding does not establish validity or trust. Five-part JWE requires decryption.
uiText.s838cf858: Raw input retains bytes. Decompression is limited incrementally to 100 MiB and validates stream integrity. Gzip accepts a single member; concatenated streams are rejected.
uiText.sdbcbabef: Bases 2–36 using BigInt, up to 10,000 digits. Integers only, with signs and matching 0b / 0o / 0x prefixes.
